name: FlashBlade - QoS cap (day 2)
description: An operator asks for an operations-per-second cap on a file system or a bucket. The request is logged, a human approves it, a QoS policy eda-cap-<object> is created when needed and assigned to the object, and the outcome is logged with the AAP job link. The client rulebook lifts the cap once the object has been normal for its configured number of polls. A rejection is logged too and changes nothing.

object_kind.title: Object kind
object_kind.description: What the name below is: a file system or a bucket

object_name.title: Object name
object_name.description: File system or bucket name as the array lists it

cap_ops_per_sec.title: Cap (operations per second)
cap_ops_per_sec.description: max_total_ops_per_sec of the eda-cap-<object> policy: a whole number of at least 1; the array refuses a value below its own minimum

extra_vars.subject: Cap ${trigger.object_kind} ${trigger.object_name} on ${trigger.array} at ${trigger.cap_ops_per_sec} ops/s: awaiting approval
extra_vars.detail: Requested through the orchestrator. Approve or reject within 24 hours.

parameters.prompt: Cap ${trigger.object_kind} ${trigger.object_name} on ${trigger.array} at ${trigger.cap_ops_per_sec} operations per second. A QoS policy eda-cap-${trigger.object_name} is created when it does not exist and assigned to the object; an object that already carries a policy of its own is left alone and recorded. The client rulebook lifts the cap once the object has been normal for qos_lift_normal_polls polls, and FlashBlade - QoS lift removes it by hand.

extra_vars.reason: requested through the orchestrator (FlashBlade - QoS cap (day 2))

extra_vars.subject: Capped ${trigger.object_kind} ${trigger.object_name} on ${trigger.array} at ${trigger.cap_ops_per_sec} ops/s
extra_vars.detail: QoS policy ${qos_cap.artifacts.policy}, capped: ${qos_cap.artifacts.capped}. The object carries the eda-cap- policy until the client rulebook lifts it or FlashBlade - QoS lift is launched. AAP job: ${qos_cap.job_url}

extra_vars.subject: QoS cap of ${trigger.object_kind} ${trigger.object_name} on ${trigger.array} at ${trigger.cap_ops_per_sec} ops/s rejected or expired; nothing changed
extra_vars.detail: The approval was rejected or timed out after 24 hours. Raise a new request if the cap is still wanted.
